notes: The two branches («ح») meet at الزهري; the names after him are written once for both routes (shared tail)
«ابنى محمد بن علي» is an apposition describing the two brothers, not written as their names: left out; «أبيهما» is a relation link
The Companion is the last link: «عن علي، قال نهى رسول الله»; the Prophet is not a link
